main.description: Record declaring a 'like' of a piece of subject content. Social feedback only: a like carries no protocol meaning about the subject (it is not an evaluation, endorsement, or acknowledgement). Schema-compatible with app.bsky.feed.like.

subject.description: Strong reference to the record being liked. May be a record of any lexicon (e.g. an activity, a collection, or a repost's subject).

createdAt.description: Client-declared timestamp when this record was originally created.

via.description: Optional strong reference to the record through which the subject was encountered, typically an app.certified.feed.repost. Lets AppViews credit the account that surfaced the subject. Mirrors the optional `via` field on app.bsky.feed.like; the referenced record may conform with any lexicon.

signatures.description: Optional cryptographic signatures attesting to this record's content.
